summary: Fixed back/tools/audit_llm_deviation.py to satisfy all P33-T1 acceptance criteria. The script already existed but had three key gaps: (1) raw_llm_response was always None (comment noted 'use shadow_runner directly'), (2) per-tick records were missing required fields agent_id, field_diffs, llm_used, failure_reason, (3) aggregate summary was missing llm_success_rate and top_violated_prompt_rules. Added import of shadow_runner.run, call it first in _run_tick_comparison to capture raw_response, then call run_comparison() for deviation verdict. Added all missing per-tick fields. Added llm_success_rate and top_violated_prompt_rules to aggregate and markdown report. All 928 existing tests pass with zero regressions.

unresolved_issues: The script calls shadow_runner.run() AND comparison_harness.run_comparison() per tick — both internally call the LLM, meaning 2 LLM calls per active tick. This is the unavoidable consequence of the contract requiring both: shadow_runner for raw_response capture and run_comparison for deviation detection without reimplementing comparison logic. The script is functional and correct; this is a performance trade-off inherent in the contract design.
